description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the GetAsyncJobResult operation for querying asynchronous task results
description_zh: 本文介绍查询异步任务结果GetAsyncJobResult的语法及示例
name: GetAsyncJobResult

parameters.help_en: The RequestId returned by the asynchronous operation. You can use this ID to query the actual result of the asynchronous operation
parameters.help_zh: 异步接口返回的RequestId，输入后可以查询异步接口的真实请求结果
parameters.name: job_id

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code of the asynchronous task

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message of the asynchronous task

Result.description_en: The actual result of the asynchronous task
Result.description_zh: 异步任务返回的真实请求结果

Status.description_en:
The status of the asynchronous task. Valid values:

QUEUING: The task is queuing.

PROCESSING: The task is being processed.

PROCESS_SUCCESS: The task is processed.

PROCESS_FAILED: The task failed to be processed.

TIMEOUT_FAILED: The task timed out.

LIMIT_RETRY_FAILED: The maximum number of retries is exceeded
Status.description_zh:
异步任务状态。包括：

QUEUING：任务排队中

PROCESSING：异步处理中

PROCESS_SUCCESS：处理成功

PROCESS_FAILED：处理失败

TIMEOUT_FAILED：任务超时未处理完成

LIMIT_RETRY_FAILED：超过最大重试次数
